en.text:
Base Class Ability Regeneration Speed is decreased by 40% while equipped.

Casting your Class Ability spawns a <strand/>'Threaded Specter' decoy in your place for 12 seconds. 

Decoy has 175 HP, 70% Damage Resistance against Combatants, and lures enemy attacks for its duration. Players deal 150% bonus damage to the decoy.

Once destroyed, or if an enemy gets within ? meters of the decoy after it has been active for 3 seconds, the decoy explodes for damage and releases two <strand/>Threadlings. 

Damage scales up to 65% increased damage at 200 Class Stat.
